title: Cyber Defenders Intro · Welcome to the Post Office (3-5)

items.q: What does a Cyber Defender protect?
choices: messages and the people who send them
the Magpie and its shiny nest
items.why: A building only holds the post. The harm happens to what is inside the messages, and to the people who wrote them, so that is what a Defender guards.

items.q: Who is the Magpie and what does it collect?
choices: a helper owl who delivers the post at night
a new post worker who sorts the mail
a pest who collects shiny secrets
a robin who collects bright ribbons
items.why: The Magpie is the pest of the story: it collects shiny secrets that are not its to keep.

items.q: Someone online you have never met says they are your friend and asks where you live. What should you do?
choices: Never share it, and tell a trusted adult
Share it, because they said they are a friend
Share just the street, not the number
Ask them a question only a real friend could answer
items.why: People online can pretend to be anyone. Where you live stays private, and a trusted adult should hear about the ask.
